claims.statement: For this programme, orientation is modelled as a temporally extended relation among an agent, a world as disclosed to that agent, and a repertoire of possible action.
claims.change: Narrowed from an unqualified constitutive thesis to a methodological definition.

claims.statement: Orientation is constitutively relational rather than exhaustively realizable as an internal state-estimation and policy-selection architecture.
claims.change: Stronger thesis split from the working definition and held for discriminating consequences.

claims.statement: Holding stimulus conditions suitably fixed, attention changes weighting, access and action selection among candidate features or affordances.
claims.change: Lower-risk processing claim separated from phenomenological disclosure.

claims.statement: Under specified conditions, attention changes the experienced affordance field rather than merely report, confidence or response threshold.
claims.change: Stronger disclosure claim isolated with an independent-discriminant requirement.

claims.statement: After material stake, coalition pressure, source trust, prior confidence and perceived threat are measured, identity centrality may add incremental prediction of the magnitude or shape of anomaly response.
claims.change: Narrowed to incremental prediction and stripped of epistemic judgement.

claims.statement: Experienced meaning does not entail empirical truth, moral warrant or metaphysical truth; particular forms of durable and corrigible integration may nevertheless carry defeasible evidential weight.
claims.change: Narrowed from non-establishment to non-entailment and restored graded evidence.

claims.statement: Correction capacity is a systems property comprising feedback availability, reception, verification, integration, enactment, retention and renewed monitoring, with separately measurable bottlenecks.
claims.change: Descriptive systems property split from normative evaluation.

claims.statement: Bounded corrigibility is presumptively valuable when correction channels provide standing, verification, proportional cost, legitimate closure and retention safeguards without destroying the agency required to learn.
claims.change: Maximal openness rejected; safeguards and defeasibility added.

claims.statement: Preregistered transformation families may recur above specified generic-narrative and shuffled-corpus null models in bounded, independently coded myth corpora.
claims.change: Occurrence claim separated from causal interpretation.

claims.statement: Diffusion, convergence under shared developmental and coordination constraints, archive selection and coder-induced abstraction make distinguishable contributions to any detected mythic recurrence.
claims.change: Explanatory alternatives promoted into the claim rather than treated as afterthoughts.

claims.statement: Explicitly justified transformations of perspective, role, time, information and affected-party position are useful diagnostics for special pleading and exclusion, but invariance under them is neither necessary nor sufficient for moral truth.
claims.change: Downgraded from proposed shape of moral truth to bounded diagnostic.

claims.statement: Christian Logos metaphysics is one comparative interpretation of the relation among intelligibility, truthful speech, self-giving transformation, personhood and reconciliation; its assessment requires precommitted criteria and serious naturalist and religious rivals.
claims.change: Held as one named rival and blocked from becoming the programme's presumed culmination.
